title: fix TLV Parser BER long-form length parsing
issueTitle: Bug report: TLV Parser produces incorrect BER-encoded lengths
why: The report gives a concrete input where the long-form BER length bytes 82 00 05 must be read as 5. The fixed parser shows a length of 5 for the first entry. The buggy parser misreads it as 130, so a length of 5 never appears.
